user.title: Kantakun Pairing
user.description:
1. Press **L3 → OK** on the Kantakun device.
2. Press **Submit** below.
3. When the device displays "Press OK", press **OK** on the device.

Setup will complete automatically.

error.pairing_timeout: Device not found. Press L3 → OK on the device and try again, or enter the IP address directly.
error.auth_failed: Failed to get authentication info from the device. Ensure pairing mode is active.
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Rinnai server. Check your network connection.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
